findings.title: The Office of Administrative Hearings (OAH) did not comply with State procurement regulations when purchasing temporary staffing services.
findings.description: OAH purchased temporary staffing services totaling $93,000 from one vendor between March 2012 and December 2013 without competitive bids or written contracts. This non-compliance means there is no assurance the lowest cost was obtained for these services.

dollar_amounts.context: temporary staffing services without obtaining competitive bids and did not enter into written contracts

findings.recommendation: We recommend that OAH comply with State procurement regulations by using a formal written procurement process (such as competitive sealed bidding) for purchases that are reasonably expected to exceed $25,000 and ensure that procurements exceeding $5,000 have formal written contracts.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The report states OAH's response to the finding and recommendation is included as an appendix, but specific agreement status or completion dates are not detailed in this document.
